plugins.cameraPermission: SnitchDog reads the number off a photo of your scale, then deletes the photo. Your weekly mirror photo stays on this phone.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: SnitchDog uses your location to find your gym when you set up your plan.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: SnitchDog checks whether you're at your gym on workout days, so workouts count without you tapping anything. Only "arrived" and "left" are worked out, on this phone; your location never leaves it.

plugins.savePhotosPermission: Only if you turn it on: SnitchDog saves your mirror photo to Photos too, so it survives a new phone.

plugins.usage: SnitchDog reads your daily step count from Apple Health to track your step goal. It only reads steps, and only the daily total leaves your phone.
